/* Formatted on 9/15/2026 11:50:06 AM (QP5 v5.362) */
SELECT distinct RAWTOHEX(m.MERCHANT_ID)MERCHANT_ID,
       m.CIF,
       m.NATIONAL_ID,
       m.BANK_ACCOUNT,
       m.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
       m.MERCHANT_NAME_AR,
       m.ADDRESS_EN,
       m.ADDRESS_AR,
       
       m.CONTRACT_MDR,
       m.CONTRACT_MDR_VALUE,
       m.CREATED_AT,
       m.CREATED_BY,
       MV.CATEGORY_MCC_MDR
 FROM MMS_MERCHANT m JOIN MMS_MCC_MDR_VW MV ON MV.MCC_ID = m.MCC_ID
 WHERE NVL (m.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0;
